title: The batch GC writes its manifests into a loop-owned directory, not the next cycle's run directory
summary: From the inbox architecture review (N4). gcHookFn(cfg, cycleWorkspace(cfg.ProjectRoot, last+1), …) (cmd_loop_prebatch.go, cmd_loop_batch.go) writes gc-shadow-manifest.json and workspace-gc-manifest.json into the run directory the next cycle will use; that cycle's archivePollutedWorkspace then renames its own workspace to .polluted-*, seen on cycles 1721, 1723, 1725, 1727 and 1731. The GC's shadow evidence is lost and the log reports a pollution that never happened.
acceptance: GC manifests are written under a batch-owned directory, never under runs/cycle-N
A cycle that starts after a pre-batch GC archives nothing (test through the pre-batch seam)
archived polluted workspace never fires for a workspace whose only files are GC manifests
